basic_details.job_title: Gauhati High Court Despatch Rider Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The recruitment is being conducted for Despatch Rider (Group-C) positions at the Aizawl Bench of the Gauhati High Court. Selected candidates will receive remuneration under Pay Level-2. The important recruitment details are provided below.

application_fee.details: Candidates must pay the prescribed application fee according to their category. The fee must be paid before the notified deadline. | Fee Payment Last Date: 27 November 2026, within bank transaction hours. | Note: The application fee is non-refundable and cannot be carried forward to another examination or selection process.

age_limit.details: The minimum age for applicants is 18 years. The maximum age limit depends on the candidate's category and will be calculated as of the last date for receipt of online applications, 21 November 2026. | Age Calculation Date: 21 November 2026. | Candidates should check the official notification for all applicable eligibility and category-related conditions before submitting their applications.

qualification.details: Applicants must satisfy the educational qualification, driving licence and language requirements prescribed under the Mizoram Despatch Rider Recruitment Rules, 2002. | Important: Possessing both the prescribed driving licences and working knowledge of the Mizo language is essential. Candidates who do not meet these requirements should not apply.

salary_details.details: The notification specifies the pay structure but does not provide an exact in-hand salary figure.

selection_process: The selection process consists of three stages: a Written Examination
a Two-Wheeler Skill Test and an Interview/Viva-Voce. Final selection will be based on marks obtained in the prescribed stages
The written examination will be an objective-type test conducted on an OMR sheet. The duration is 60 minutes
The Mizo language proficiency section is qualifying in nature. Candidates must obtain at least 40% marks
in this section. Marks scored in the Mizo language segment will not be considered while preparing the merit list.

Candidates shortlisted in a ratio of 1:5 based on their written examination merit will be called for the skill test. The skill test carries 40 marks and evaluates practical two-wheeler riding abilities.
The riding test will be conducted using a two-wheeler vehicle with or without gear. Candidates must secure at least 50% marks
to qualify for the skill test.
Candidates will be shortlisted for the Interview/Viva-Voce in a ratio of 1:3 based on their performance in the written examination and skill test. The interview carries 20 marks.
Applicants must secure at least 12 out of 20 marks (60%) to qualify for the interview stage. Document verification will also be conducted as part of the selection process.
Final selection will be based on the combined marks obtained in the written examination
excluding the qualifying Mizo language component from the merit calculation.
In the event of a tie
preference will be given first to the candidate securing higher written examination marks
followed by higher skill test marks. If a tie still remains
the older candidate will receive preference.
The Gauhati High Court reserves the right to fix or modify the cutoff marks for the selection stages.
how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the Gauhati High Court website or the Aizawl Bench website. Applicants must have an active email address and mobile number before starting the registration process.
Visit the official website at ghconline.gov.in or ghcazlbench.nic.in.
Find the link titled "Online application for the post of Despatch Rider (Group-C) in the Aizawl Bench of the Gauhati High Court".
Open the application portal and complete registration using a valid email address and mobile number.
Note down the Registration Code generated during registration.
Fill in the required personal details, educational qualification details and other information in the application form.
Upload clear scanned copies of the required certificates and supporting documents.
Check all entered information carefully before final submission.
Submit the online application before 21 November 2026, within office working hours.
Pay the prescribed application fee before 27 November 2026, within bank transaction hours.
Save the application details, Registration Code and payment confirmation for future reference.
Important: No changes or corrections to the application form will be permitted after submission. Applications submitted through any mode other than the prescribed online process will be rejected.
Candidates must upload the prescribed scanned documents when submitting their online applications.
Age proof such as Birth Certificate or Class X Admit Card
Educational qualification mark sheet or pass certificate
No Objection Certificate (NOC), if employed in Government Service
Applicants must also produce their original certificates and other relevant records whenever required during subsequent stages of the recruitment process.
important_instructions: Candidates must fulfil all prescribed educational, age, driving licence and language requirements. Incomplete applications, including those without the required photograph or signature, may be rejected. All details provided in the online application must be accurate and supported by valid documents. Candidates already employed in Government Service must comply with the prescribed employer intimation and NOC requirements. No travelling allowance or daily allowance (TA/DA) will be provided for attending the written examination, skill test or interview. The number of vacancies may change at the time of final selection. The High Court may publish provisional lists of eligible and rejected candidates on its official website.

content_sections.heading: Gauhati High Court Despatch Rider Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of three stages: a Written Examination, a Two-Wheeler Skill Test and an Interview/Viva-Voce. Final selection will be based on marks obtained in the prescribed stages, subject to the qualifying conditions. The written examination will be an objective-type test conducted on an OMR sheet. The duration is 60 minutes, and the paper carries 60 marks. The Mizo language proficiency section is qualifying in nature. Candidates must obtain at least 40% marks, equivalent to 8 out of 20, in this section. Marks scored in the Mizo language segment will not be considered while preparing the merit list. Candidates shortlisted in a ratio of 1:5 based on their written examination merit will be called for the skill test. The skill test carries 40 marks and evaluates practical two-wheeler riding abilities. The riding test will be conducted using a two-wheeler vehicle with or without gear. Candidates must secure at least 50% marks, equivalent to 20 out of 40, to qualify for the skill test. Candidates will be shortlisted for the Interview/Viva-Voce in a ratio of 1:3 based on their performance in the written examination and skill test. The interview carries 20 marks. Applicants must secure at least 12 out of 20 marks (60%) to qualify for the interview stage. Document verification will also be conducted as part of the selection process. Final selection will be based on the combined marks obtained in the written examination, skill test and interview, excluding the qualifying Mizo language component from the merit calculation. In the event of a tie, preference will be given first to the candidate securing higher written examination marks, followed by higher skill test marks. If a tie still remains, the older candidate will receive preference. The Gauhati High Court reserves the right to fix or modify the cutoff marks for the selection stages.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for the Despatch Rider post?
faq.answer: The Gauhati High Court has announced a total of 3 vacancies for the post of Despatch Rider at the Aizawl Bench for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Middle School Leaving Certificate. Additionally, they must possess a two-wheeler driving license along with a Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) driving license.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years for Unreserved category candidates and 18 to 40 years for SC/ST candidates, calculated as of the last date of application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for the Despatch Rider post?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for Unreserved category candidates and Rs. 250/- for SC/ST candidates, payable through online mode only.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary scale for the Despatch Rider?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be placed in Pay level-2, with a salary range of Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 44,400 per month as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises three stages: a Written Examination (60 marks), a Skill Test (40 marks), and an Interview/Viva-voce (20 marks).

faq.question: Q7. Is knowledge of the Mizo language mandatory?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have a working knowledge of the Mizo language up to the Middle School standard, which is a mandatory requirement for this position.

faq.question: Q8. When is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the online application form is 21 November 2026. Ensure you submit your application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q9. Can I pay the application fee after the application deadline?
faq.answer: The last date for the payment of the application fee is 27 November 2026, which is a few days after the application submission deadline.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the job be located?
faq.answer: The vacancies are specifically for the Aizawl Bench of the Gauhati High Court, and the selected candidates will be posted in Aizawl, Mizoram.
